title: Mark the `--migrate-db` option to `podman system migrate` as hidden, and remove it from the Manpages
body: With Podman 6.0, database migration is now automatic. As such, this option is now superfluous and no longer needed. We can't remove it until 7.0 - that'd be a breaking change - but we can mark it as hidden so people don't accidentally stumble on it.
